$comment: Source of truth for the compliance evidence report. Tests link to these with Playwright tags (e.g. { tag: '@R1' }). A requirement with no tagged tests is reported as a coverage gap.

requirements.title: A user with valid credentials can sign in and sign out
requirements.control: OWASP Top 10 A07: Identification and Authentication Failures

requirements.title: Invalid credentials are rejected with an error and no session is created
requirements.control: OWASP Top 10 A07: Identification and Authentication Failures

requirements.title: The password field masks what the user types
requirements.control: OWASP Top 10 A07: Identification and Authentication Failures

requirements.title: GET /api/tests returns every test once, matching its JSON contract
Unknown or malicious test names return 404 and run nothing
requirements.control: OWASP Top 10 A01: Broken Access Control; A03: Injection

requirements.title: A test run streams its steps, then exactly one result
Every test execution is recorded with its result and duration
requirements.control: Execution records retained in the system of record

requirements.title: Run history reported by the API reconciles to the database
Tests with inconsistent results are flagged as flaky
Invalid query parameters return 400 and SQL injection has no effect
API response time stays within the p95 budget
requirements.control: Service level: p95 within budget (default 300 ms)

requirements.title: Dashboard pages meet WCAG 2.1 AA and work with a keyboard
Recorded tests never contain hard-coded URLs or credentials
The Recorder shows steps live, cleans the code, and saves, runs and deletes recordings
Recorder input is validated and saved files cannot be reached by path traversal
requirements.control: OWASP Top 10 A01: Broken Access Control; A03: Injection

requirements.title: A multi-factor challenge is shown when the bank requires it
requirements.control: OWASP Top 10 A07: Identification and Authentication Failures
